SharedInput.description: A unique Arc admission preserves the original allocation only when exclusive strong ownership and absence of Weak aliases are proven together. Refused admission returns the input unchanged. Subsequent immutable first-party aliases expose no Weak or raw ownership. Payload birth and whole header release have independent exact grant receipts.

Grant.description: Distinct caller authorities govern retained metadata events, logical copies, exact new scaffold births, whole physical releases and frontier depth. A shared alias release does not earn physical allocation credit. Last node/entry/key/value owners expose their real next allocation demand before movement. Owned values transfer to their defining controlled retirement authority. Key length visits are not physical backing releases.

Progress.description: Actual allocator requests and frees equal the independently observed capacity/release receipts for the step. Zero items and one-short physical grants are inert. Terminal disposal has no remaining allocation or payload custody. Borrowed ranked views never dispose their original source.
